investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocks All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-10-15T12:37 with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api's POST /api/agents call could not reach the swarm gateway at the redacted AWS ELB endpoint in us-east-2. Because the failure is shared across every sibling check with the same error message, the fault is localized to the swarm gateway layer, not to any individual eval or check-specific code path.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the AWS ELB-backed service at http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents — was unreachable from the production-api at the time of the eval run. The production-api returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "error sending request for url (http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents)" for every attempt to POST /api/agents. Because all three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) depend on this same upstream call to provision a remote agent, all three failed with the identical message. No evidence was collected (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState all missing), confirming the request never reached the swarm backend. This is an eval-detected infrastructure connectivity failure localized to the swarm gateway dependency; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
